messages:
Maria: heads-up — noticed PR evals are sporadically skipping the GH Actions gating since last schedule tweak. around merges they either never start or time out after 15m.
Kevin: any logs/skipped reason? flaky runners or filters?
Maria: gist of log: 
```
[2026-03-19T01:03:12Z] evaluate-pr: queued
[2026-03-19T01:03:40Z] evaluate-pr: no workflow_run trigger matched, skipping
[2026-03-19T01:03:40Z] evaluate-pr: reason=filter_mismatch event=push actor=bob
```
Selena: buildkite evals seem to run fine, but we get long backpressure in the runner pool at merge windows. BK has queue depth spiking at the same times GH Actions shows skips.
Kevin: sounds like a timing/race between merge -> repo_dispatch -> workflow filter. maybe our schedule/jitter is too coarse and we get bursts that trip dedupe or some bot-based throttling.
Maria: also noticed for forks we see `no GITHUB_TOKEN` errors intermittently (fork PRs don't get secrets on scheduled workflows) — that might silently fail our PR gating if we rely on a scheduled run.
Selena: solution sketch: 1) add small per-pr jitter to scheduled dispatches (random 0-120s) 2) change GH filters to explicitly allow `pull_request` and `workflow_dispatch` events used by repo_dispatch 3) fall back to Buildkite canary trigger if GH Actions skip.
Kevin: +1. For 2) can you paste the snippet you propose?
Maria: here's a minimal `workflow_dispatch`-forwarding action we can add to the org repo: 
```yaml
on: [repository_dispatch, workflow_dispatch, pull_request]

jobs:
  forward-to-evals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: forward
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const type = context.eventName
            core.info(`forwarding event=${type}`)
            await github.repos.createDispatchEvent({owner, repo: 'evals', event_type: 'from-ci', client_payload: {pr: context.payload.pull_request?.number}})
```
Selena: for BK we can add a small `depends_on` gate so warm-pool allocs get prioritized during bursts: 
```yaml
steps:
  - label: "alloc-warm-pool"
    command: ./scripts/alloc_warm_pool.sh
  - wait: ~
  - label: "run-evals"
    command: ./run_evals.sh
    depends_on: ["alloc-warm-pool"]
```
Kevin: one more: dedupe artifact uploads are causing our PR vs nightly artifact mismatch. PRs upload small eval artifacts that get pruned; nightly tries to compare and errors out. we should tag artifacts with `pr-<num>` and keep for 48h.
Maria: agree. metric-wise we saw `pr-eval-flaky-rate` spike from 2% -> 14% during an hour window at 01:00 UTC. jitter + warm-pool should smooth that.
Selena: i'll add a tiny randomized sleep in the repo_dispatch runner and open a PR for the BK wait change. will also add artifact tag retention change.
CI Bot: re-run requested by @Selena — evals workflow queued (id: 983721) :arrows_clockwise:
Kevin: let's run the experiment tonight on staging (staging repo_dispatch + bk warm-pool). if green, promote to prod. i'll add the gating doc and roll plan.
Maria: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/412 — plan: 1) add jitter + dispatch forwarding 2) BK warm-pool wait 3) artifact tags + retention 4) monitor `pr-eval-flaky-rate` for 24h — assigning to @Selena and @Kevin.
Selena: on it, will update status in the issue.
Maria: thanks — feel free to ping me if you need helper infra creds. :thumbsup:
